notes: [homefix-01 on 9e7d9980: branch homefix-on-9e7d998 @ <branch ] OWNER APPROVED 2026-10-19 (expansion X1/X9; lifts the 09-30 no-stuck-hunts rule for this fix), restart 10-20 ~12:00Z. H1 home grades arrival with goto's own final test (arrivedAt: <= 3 h, |dy| <= 6); H2 the watchdog rescue contract (pending from the verdict, Runner.reserve cancel-and-reserve -> runner_reserved, current always cleared, level held + 180 s backoff on a rescue that did not start, capped at 2 reserve_expired -> level 3 reconnect, window reset at rescue start, _watchdog_rescue attempt rows, _stagnation args.window_from); one declined set (declined.mjs) every outcome handler imports; H3 the runner files any throw under its own aborted signal as aborted/interrupted; H4 HOME_BUDGET_MS 170 s and `until` into nested goto/surface. licence.note: Only this build writes _watchdog_rescue (rescuerow.mjs logRescueRow: the watchdog at requested/tick_seen/reconnected, the runner at started/declined/terminal). Run licencecheck before the draw.

change_rows_note: Written WITHOUT the underscore on purpose: verdict.py compares skill.name.lstrip("_") against the raw change_rows set (verdict.py:531, :546, :593), and changerowcheck.py the same way, so "_watchdog_rescue" would never match a death window.

draw_exposure.note: Dry run 10-20 (hive-c + placebo-b, 24 h): 501 level-1 _stagnation verdicts and 52 home rows on 10 bots. Every shared pool escalates; G1 is the slow gate.

exposure.note: exposure_ready = gates_complete OR the arm-size deadline (+540 at >= 4 pools, +720 at 3, +1080 at <= 2) reached. Before it the extension continues (NOT_YET); at it, gates_complete 0 blocks KEEP -> INCONCLUSIVE.

own_lines.note: G1 ARRIVAL: an arm `home` row (trigger not interrupt:*, moved >= 2) ending in the H1 band (2 < horizontal <= 3, |dy| <= 6 of config.world home; counted only 0.08 inside each edge: bot.pos is rounded to 0.1) graded anything but success. D = 2 (pre-fix 224/240 = 93.3%).
G1b MIRROR: an arm `home` SUCCESS ending > 3.08 horizontally or |dy| > 6.08 (the fix must not over-accept; 0.08 = the rounding of bot.pos).
G2 CLASSIFICATION: an arm `home`/`surface` row with an interrupt:* trigger filed failed/skill_error. D = 5, or the arm mix's own D (P(0|no fix) <= 0.05 at home 18.7% / surface 73.5%, h12).

G3 RESCUE SURVIVES: a started `_watchdog_rescue` attempt (joined to its skill row, start +-1 s) cut by interrupt:stagnation from a verdict whose window_from precedes the rescue start (or with no verdict row); with no skill row the runner's own terminal phase stands in. D = 8 (proxy 34%).

G4 RESCUE REACHABLE: a `requested` attempt (>= 260 s before the read boundary: the 230 s bound + margin) with no terminal phase (completed:*, interrupted:*, declined:*, reconnected); a respawn inside the bound CENSORS it (reported, not an opportunity). D = 20.

G4 RATE DEFECT (the spec's reserve_expired > 8%, made robust at small n per Claude code r1 P3-7): the one-sided 95% Wilson LOWER bound of declined:reserve_expired / attempts is above 8%, judged from >= 20 attempts (needs >= 4 of 20; a true 4.1% reaches that 0.8% of the time).
ARMS: control `_watchdog_rescue` rows (only this build writes them). BLOCKS KEEP.
READABLE: every enabled canary bot (systemd roster) has post-window rows on the canary build, every canary home is readable from its env file, no log file failed to load. BLOCKS KEEP.
G3 EVIDENCE: a started rescue with neither its skill row nor a terminal phase (past its 230 s bound, no respawn inside it) cannot be graded. BLOCKS KEEP.
G1 CONTROL: the same reader finds >= 1 G1 defect on the arm's own 24 h pre-period (old code). Dry run hive-c+placebo-b 10-20: 9 of 9. VOID -> BLOCKS KEEP.
G1b CONTROL: fixtures (the two pre-fix dy -10 successes, h9) are flagged. VOID -> BLOCKS KEEP.
G2 CONTROL: the same reader finds >= 1 G2 defect on the arm's own 24 h pre-period. Dry run: 45 (22 home / 43 surface opportunities). VOID -> BLOCKS KEEP.

G3 CONTROL: (a) the historical proxy (watchdog-origin row <= 30 s after a `_stagnation`, cut by interrupt:stagnation < 150 s) finds >= 1 defect on the pre-period (dry run 27 of 221) AND (b) the new reader passes the good fixtures and fails the defective ones (cut at 15 s, delayed handoff cut 5 s later, cut before 10 s). VOID -> BLOCKS KEEP.
G4 CONTROL: fixtures only (no-terminal attempt flagged; reconnect with its row and a declined attempt pass). VOID -> BLOCKS KEEP.

G4 RATE BAR (point estimate): declined:reserve_expired > 8% of >= 20 attempts (2x the 4.1% unwind-latency proxy) BLOCKS KEEP (INCONCLUSIVE); only the lower-bound line above REVERTS. body_held / runner_paused rates are reported only (pre-fix rates unmeasured).

EVERY GATE HAS ITS D (G1 >= 2, G2 >= 5 and P(0|no fix) <= 0.05 on the arm mix, G3 >= 8, G4 >= 20). Before the arm-size deadline exposure_ready is 0 and the extension continues; AT the deadline exposure_ready is 1 and this line BLOCKS KEEP -> INCONCLUSIVE.

primary.note: REPORTED, NOT GATED: home success all rows and an S0-like filter (canary/control x pre/post), relocation outcomes, reserve_expired / body_held / runner_paused rates.

harm.note: Unchanged: the two-death floor (OWNER 2026-09-11) and gather_ratio < 0.43 of control, from immobiledid. REPORTED by homefixread (DiD, never a verdict there): deaths, canary deaths within 120 s after a _watchdog_rescue start, _stranded* per bot-h, level-1 _stagnation per bot-h, _stagnation_reconnect per bot-h (NOT expected to fall: item 4 keeps the reconnect for wedged skills), relocation outcomes (H2a turns on ~7.6k level-1 relocations a week that never started before; they must not raise deaths or strandings).

teardown.note: THREE STEPS: drop-ins, clear canary_pool, restart the pool's bots 12 s apart; then confirm the live versions. Nothing in the world to undo.

extension.note: G1 is the slow gate: 1.43 opportunities per 3 h at 20 bots (h13). The read sets exposure_ready at its arm-size deadline, so a 4-pool arm closes at +540 and a 3-pool arm at +720.
